name: AgenticOpsEval
description: OverviewAgenticOpsEval is a multimodal dataset suite for evaluating both the final diagnoses and diagnostic processes of large language model (LLM) agents in microservice failure diagnosis. Beyond root-cause entities and fault-type labels, it provides fine-grained process-level annotations of the key observability evidence and failure-propagation paths required to support a diagnosis. These annotations make it possible to assess whether an agent reaches an evidence-grounded conclusion rather than merely producing a correct final answer.AgenticOpsEval contains 503 expert-annotated failure cases collected from two microservice testbeds. It organizes evaluation along three dimensions: Localization of the root-cause entity, Identification of the fault type, and Reason assessment based on supporting evidence or causal chains.DatasetsAIOps2025 contains 400 fault-injection cases collected from HipsterShop with TiDB and Redis on Kubernetes. Each task provides a natural-language anomaly description and a diagnostic time window for retrieving relevant metrics, logs, and traces. The annotations cover 9 fault categories and 18 fault types across service, pod, and node levels.
